source.post_text:
Jason Schreier explains why the anti-consumer concerns about the GTA 6 extended look being a timed exclusive on Netflix are overblown:

“6 hours is not a lot of time in the grand scheme of things. It doesn’t really hurt anybody to have a gameplay footage available on Netflix 6 hours in advance. I mean this is all marketing, it’s not like we’re talking about a video game being made only available to some subset of players.

replies.text: I see both sides but six hours of early Netflix access for pure marketing footage really doesn't move the needle much. Most folks will catch the trailer whenever, so the consumer-hostile framing feels overstated compared to bigger industry issues.
